page.layout: One column of running text on the left printed page; below the text a catchword at the right. The right printed page is only a cut-off strip at the scan edge and is not transcribed. No margin notes on this page.

main_text.p: nqratorum[?] arbitrium, electio cle-ricorum. Et Romæ tantum valuit ol m[?] imperatoris auctoritas in epi-scopis ornandis, ut Gregorius di-cat epist. lib. 1. epist. 5. se ipsius iussu in ecclesiæ gubernaculis constitutum esse, quum tamen solenniter à po-pulo fuisse expetitus.
main_text.head: Refutatio objectionum pontifi-ciarum.
main_text.p: Objiciunt[?] pontificii 1. Jerem. 23. 21. rejicit illos doctores qui currunt non misi a Deo, & Rom 10. dici, quomodo prædicabunt, nisi mittantur? Itaque ne-minem debere, licet sit doctissimus, minis-terium in ecclesia usurpare, sine peculiari & legitima vocatione. Profitentium doctores autem destitui legitima vocationis testimonium. Resp. doctores protesta-tium non destitui, legitima vocati-one demonstravimus antea. 2 Non intelligi vocationem immediatam; sed Deum mittere servos suos per vocatione & electionem ecclesiæ: ac proinde minis-terium tantum penes illos esse, qui à Deo per ecclesiam sunt electi, atque hoc ipsum incul-

page.notes: The first letter of "Objiciunt" is a large initial and hard to read; read as O with [?]. "ol m" in the third line of the first column is blurred and uncertain. The first line is blurred by show-through from the reverse page, and "nqratorum" is uncertain. The "2" before "Non" is a small raised figure whose function is unclear. The right edge of the neighbouring page is cut off and was left out.
